artworks.title: American Widgeon
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two American wigeons standing on rocks near a body of water. The painting features two ducks, one painted with browns and grays, and the other with a mix of brown, white, and green. They are perched on rocks in a serene aquatic setting.

artworks.title: Black-throated Diver
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of black-throated divers. It depicts three birds, two in the water and one perched on land. The birds have medium to large bodies with patterned plumage, featuring a black throat. The bird on the left stands on land with white markings on its black wings and a red eye, while the other two birds are in the water, one with its beak open and the other gazing calmly. The background shows a waterbody with distant hills under a soft blue sky.

artworks.title: Smew or White Nun
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds against a backdrop of a mountainous landscape. One bird is flying and the other is swimming. The flying bird is a Smew duck with black and white plumage and red eyes. The swimming bird is also a Smew with a red-brown head. The water has gentle ripples and the background shows a mountainous landscape with layered ridges. The sky is a pale blue color.

artworks.title: Gadwall Duck
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two ducks perched on a rocky landscape. The painting features two gadwall ducks. The duck on the left exhibits warm brown plumage with intricate patterns on its feathers, while the duck on the right displays gray, white, and chestnut hues with detailed feather texture. The backdrop consists of a subtle gradient of sky and a rocky ledge beneath the ducks. The style is reminiscent of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Least Water-hen
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds near a water body surrounded by reeds. The painting features a least water hen and a chick walking along the edge of a small waterway. The adult bird has dark brown plumage with white speckles, and the chick has a darker, more uniform color. Both birds have yellow legs. In the background, tall green reeds sway, and a distant horizon is painted with clouds under a blue sky. This creates a serene scene resembling a marshy habitat. The style is similar to John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Rocky Mountain Plover
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird standing on a grassy terrain with mountains in the background. The painting depicts a detailed and realistic illustration of a bird, labeled as the "Rocky Mountain Plover." The bird stands prominently in the foreground, showcasing delicate and intricate feather patterns in shades of brown, white, and black. Its posture is slightly hunched as it walks along the green expanse, with a small piece of rock nearby. The background features a serene landscape of distant mountains under a pale blue sky with a soft gradient effect. The painting captures a moment of natural beauty and pays close attention to detail.

artworks.title: Great Cinereous Owl
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of an owl perched on a branch in the style of John James Audubon. The image depicts a Great Grey Owl with a detailed and realistic portrayal of its features. The owl is shown in profile with its head turned towards the viewer, showcasing intricate patterns on its feathers. The owl's plumage is rendered in shades of brown and grey, with a light cream facial disc and distinct concentric circle patterns. Its wings are folded against its body, and its talons are gripping a branch. The backdrop consists of a soft blue sky with fluffy white clouds. The composition emphasizes the majesty and beauty of the owl in its natural setting.

artworks.title: Black-winged Hawk
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two black-winged hawks. The painting features one hawk perched on a branch, while the other soars in the air above. The hawk on the branch is depicted with detailed plumage, highlighting its black wings and white body. Its talons grip the branch firmly, and it gazes upwards. The airborne hawk is captured mid-flight, with wings spread, against a softly rendered sky. Both hawks have red eyes and open beaks, adding a sense of interaction. The artwork is detailed and vibrant, showcasing the artist's skill in rendering avian subjects. This is in the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Chestnut-backed Titmouse, Black-capped Titmouse and Chestnut-crowned Titmouse
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: The image shows a large woven nest attached to a branch with several birds surrounding it. The birds range in size and are perched both on branches and near the nest. The color palette is soft, with browns, grays, and whites in the birds, contrasted against the green leaves and earthy tones of the nest. The nest is positioned centrally on diagonally crossing branches, with birds at varying angles and distances from it, creating a balanced composition.

artworks.title: Louisiana Tanager and Scarlet Tanager
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of tanager birds perched on branches. The painting features four birds with colorful plumage. Two birds have yellow and red plumage with black wings, one bird is deep red with black wings, and another bird has olive-green and yellow tones. The birds are depicted around green leafy branches. The detailed renderings and naturalistic style suggest an emphasis on ornithological study. This is in the style of John James Audubon, known for detailed illustrations of birds and their natural habitats.

artworks.title: MacGillivray's Finch
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds perched among tall green leaves with butterflies fluttering nearby. The artwork depicts two small birds with brown plumage, resting on slender green leaves. Above them, two butterflies with patterned wings add a sense of movement to the scene. The background is a soft, neutral tone, allowing the subjects to stand out in vivid detail.

artworks.title: Marsh Hawk
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting three marsh hawks in different poses. The top hawk has orange-brown feathers with detailed patterns, standing with partially open wings and its head slightly turned down. The second hawk below it has bluish-grey plumage with yellow eyes, perched on a branch. The third hawk at the bottom appears to be feeding with its head down, set against a background of grasses and water. The scene is detailed, showing the birds' plumage and the habitat.

artworks.title: American Magpie
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two American Magpies. One magpie is in flight and the other is perched on a branch. The magpie in flight has black, white, and iridescent green and blue feathers. The other magpie has similar coloring, with its wings folded against its body. The focus on detail highlights the beauty of these birds. The painting is in the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Pine Grosbeak
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: The image shows three birds perched on branches of a pine tree. The central bird is a pink pine grosbeak with black and white wings. Another bird with brown and black feathers is on the top right branch, and a grayish-black bird is on the top left branch. The pine branches have slender needles, and the background is cream-colored with hints of green and blue.

artworks.title: Arkansaw Flycatcher, Swallow-tailed Flycatcher and Says Flycatcher
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of various colorful birds perched on branches along with butterflies. The image depicts a collection of birds and butterflies. Each bird exhibits distinct markings, such as vivid reds, yellows, and subtle browns. The background is a plain, neutral hue.

artworks.title: Winter Wren and Rock Wren
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: Four birds perched on branches and greenery. The largest bird is on the left side along a horizontal branch. The color palette includes earthy browns, greens, and hints of pale blue on the branch moss, with the birds displaying a mix of rich brown and buff tones. One bird is on the left cactus-like branch, another in the center on a vertical branch, one bird is on moss-covered ground in the lower right, and another near the lower center pecking at the moss. The background is cream.

artworks.title: Long-tailed or Dusky Grous
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is an image of two Long-tailed or Dusky Grouse set against a mountainous landscape. The birds are depicted with intricate feather detail and red eye combs, standing on grassy and rocky terrain. The background shows mountain formations in soft tones, with a pale blue sky. The style is reminiscent of John James Audubon, known for realistic bird portrayals in natural settings.

artworks.title: Yellow-billed Magpie, Stellers Jay, Ultramarine Jay and Clark's Crow
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: The image depicts several birds in various positions on branches in a natural setting. The color scheme includes blue, black, white, green, yellow, and brown hues. The birds are positioned within a foliage-filled background, with some interacting with seeds.

artworks.title: Bohemian Chatterer
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds perched on a branch with clusters of orange berries and green leaves. The scene depicts two Bohemian Waxwings, showcasing the intricate details of their plumage, including patterns of yellow-tipped tails and red markings on their wings. One bird leans towards the other, suggesting interaction. The foliage around them has a few sprigs bearing clusters of orange berries. The composition is vividly colored, capturing the beauty of avian life in their habitat. The style is reminiscent of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: White-winged Crossbill
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: The image shows three birds on a branch with green berries and leaves. The birds are red and black with white wing markings. The color palette includes red, green, black, white, and neutrals. The birds are positioned in the center, with two facing each other and one reaching for berries above them.

artworks.title: Lapland Longspur
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of Lapland Longspurs in a natural landscape. The image shows three birds on a rocky terrain by a body of water with foliage and mountains in the distance. The birds have detailed plumage patterns and coloration. The sky above has a gentle gradient. The style is reminiscent of John James Audubon, known for detailed bird and nature renderings.

artworks.title: Iceland or Jer Falcon
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two white falcons with black markings. The image depicts two falcons, one flying and the other perched on a rocky ledge. The falcons have white plumage with black markings. The flying falcon has its wings spread wide, showcasing the patterns on its feathers, while the perched falcon appears to be vocalizing with its beak open. The ledge is against a gradient sky of deep blue. The painting captures the majesty and elegance of the birds with attention to detail in their feathers and expressions. This is in the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Band-tailed Pigeon
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two band-tailed pigeons perched on a flowering branch. The illustration shows two pigeons with banded tails, sitting on a branch with leaves and flowers. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Rock Grous
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of three birds on a rocky landscape with mountains in the background. The artwork features three rock ptarmigans standing on a rocky outcrop. One bird is white with brown feathers and a red circle around its eye. Another bird has a mix of white and brown feathers. The third bird has brown and gold plumage with intricate markings. The backdrop shows mountains under a blue sky. Grass and shrubs are present in the scene. The composition highlights the unique characteristics of each bird, with subtle color tones emphasizing the ambiance of the scene.
